text:
Noah: dropped new mock for autoscale controls. main gripe: SLO slider dominates and pushes pool selector off-screen. can we collapse it?
Ivy: +1. idea: show SLO summary pill 'SLO: 99.9th · 120ms' and expand slider inline on click. keeps page tidy.
Theo: also, burst explainer is too long. suggest 1-line 'Burst: temporary extra capacity' + 'learn more' link that opens a small panel with ascii timeline and estimate.
Samira: a11y note: don't rely on hover. make the learn-more a focusable button with aria-expanded. A11yBot: slider should expose aria-valuetext 'SLO target: {value} ms' and keyboard step 5ms.
Noah: labeling debate — users confuse Max vs Burst. proposal: keep 'Max' but subtitle '(sustained)'. short and clarifies.
Ivy: also collapse pool chips when >2 to '2 selected +N' to reduce visual noise. keyboard users need to open and tab through chips.
Theo: final: suggestion pill when SLO too strict -> 'Suggest: raise Min to 3' with preview cost delta and one-click apply. must be reversible.
Samira: timeline? I can mock pill and panel by EOD tomorrow. Theo will spec aria and cost endpoint. Noah to add Figma comments.
Noah: thanks everyone — leaving comments and will follow up in product sync. :thumbsup:
